اعتديتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَدَيْتُمْ (iʕtadaytum) /iʕ.ta.daj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# اُعْتُدِيتُمْ (uʕtudītum) /uʕ.tu.diː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
